crossRefs.note: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunder storm,
“Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, That abundance of waters may cover you?
Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are?’

“Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.
The children of Israel went into the middle of the sea on the dry ground, and the waters were a wall to them on their…
The waters returned, and covered the chariots and the horsemen, even all Pharaoh’s army that went in after them into…
He has cast Pharaoh’s chariots and his army into the sea. His chosen captains are sunk in the Red Sea.
The deeps cover them. They went down into the depths like a stone.
He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.

translations.web: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.
translations.bsb: See how He scatters His lightning around Him and covers the depths of the sea.
translations.kjv: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea.
translations.asv: Behold, he spreadeth his light around him; And he covereth the bottom of the sea.
